title: Baked Quince with Cinnamon
nutrition_tip: Baked quince with cinnamon recipe bakes quince, an aromatic fruit, with red wine…

ingredients.name: 3 quince, unpeeled, washed, halved and cored

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Press 3 cloves into each quince half; place quince, cut-sides down, into a roasting pan. Add water, wine, and cinnamon sticks to the pan; sprinkle sugar over fruit.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 35 to 40 minutes. Flip quince halves; continue baking until tender, about 10 minutes more. Cool quince slightly, about 10 minutes.
Serve each quince half with 1 tablespoon juice from the roasting pan; dollop halves with whipped cream.
